# MDD Sim Gateway v1.7.0

## 中文

### 1. v1.7.0 本次版本更新

- 通过 [PR #31](https://github.com/MddIdd/mdd-sim-gateway/pull/31) 新增飞书/Lark 自定义机器人通知，
  与 Webhook、Telegram 和 PushPlus 共用分事件开关、
  消息模板、测试推送、失败重试和投递记录。支持官方飞书/Lark 地址及可选 HMAC-SHA256
  签名；平台返回业务错误时不再误报成功，支持包也会脱敏 Token 和签名密钥。
- 修复 [Issue #33](https://github.com/MddIdd/mdd-sim-gateway/issues/33)：部分运营商会在固定时间后
  静默作废 SWu 会话，原有 IKE-SA 主动换钥默认 600 分钟且无法配置，导致 giffgaff/O2 UK
  线路约每 2 小时 50 分钟掉线。现在可全局或按线路配置 IKE 换钥间隔，默认 150 分钟；
  原有 30 分钟 ESP 换钥保持不变。
- 系统设置可列出并安装已发布的候选测试版，也可切回正常 Release；草稿不显示，
  自动更新仍受稳定版推送策略控制。Telegram 和系统更新支持直连、明确的代理库条目或
  国家出口；订阅只通过国家出口选择，旧设置会迁移到原先实际使用的出口。
- 修复 [Issue #21](https://github.com/MddIdd/mdd-sim-gateway/issues/21) 和
  [Issue #30](https://github.com/MddIdd/mdd-sim-gateway/issues/30)：临时读取不到 modem IMEI 不再清空
  已验证身份，已启用的原生读卡器线路也不再被“新设备默认关闭 VoWiFi”错误阻止恢复。
  独立有界的 lifecycle 记录会保留调度、阻断、取消、失败和成功决策；支持包新增覆盖范围、
  截断状态和 10 MiB 上限，同时继续排除订阅者与硬件身份。
- 修复 [Issue #27](https://github.com/MddIdd/mdd-sim-gateway/issues/27)：VLESS Encryption 参数现在会正确传给
  Xray，不再因固定发送 `none` 而全部超时。UDP 出口验证交叉使用 STUN 和 DNS 探测，Xray
  不可用时只影响由它承载的出口；节点测试会同时显示 Xray/sing-box 的真实失败原因。
- 通知事件开关现在与消息模板一样折叠，通道测试期间会显示“测试中…”并禁止重复点击；
  系统更新的联网说明和版本范围说明也已放回各自对应的控件下方。

### 2. v1.7 功能概览

- 通知通道扩展到飞书/Lark，并统一了事件模板、测试反馈、重试和投递记录。
- VoWiFi 通过可配置的 IKE-SA 换钥和更可追溯的自动恢复记录，改善长时间运行的稳定性。
- 候选版管理、明确的通知/更新出口和更完整的代理诊断，让测试、回退和故障定位都可在 WebUI 完成。

本版本需要同时更新 Control 与 Engine。

---

## English

### 1. v1.7.0 release changes

- [PR #31](https://github.com/MddIdd/mdd-sim-gateway/pull/31) adds Feishu/Lark custom bots
  alongside Webhook, Telegram and PushPlus, sharing per-event switches,
  message templates, test delivery, retries and delivery history. Official Feishu/Lark endpoints
  and optional HMAC-SHA256 signing are supported; application-level rejection is no longer mistaken
  for HTTP success, and support bundles redact bot tokens and signing secrets.
- Fix [Issue #33](https://github.com/MddIdd/mdd-sim-gateway/issues/33): some carriers silently
  invalidate SWu sessions on a fixed clock, while the old proactive IKE-SA rekey defaulted to an
  unconfigurable 600 minutes, making giffgaff/O2 UK lines drop about every 2h50m. The IKE rekey can
  now be configured globally or per line and defaults to 150 minutes; the existing 30-minute ESP
  rekey is unchanged.
- System Settings can list and install published candidate Releases or switch back to a normal
  Release. Drafts stay hidden and automatic updates remain governed by stable promotion policy.
  Telegram and software updates can use direct networking, a specific proxy-library entry or a
  country exit; subscriptions are selected only through country exits, with old selections migrated
  to the route they previously used.
- Fix [Issue #21](https://github.com/MddIdd/mdd-sim-gateway/issues/21) and
  [Issue #30](https://github.com/MddIdd/mdd-sim-gateway/issues/30): a transient modem IMEI read
  failure no longer erases verified identity, and an enabled native-reader line is no longer denied
  recovery by the “VoWiFi off for new devices” default. A separate bounded lifecycle log retains
  scheduling, blocking, cancellation, failure and success decisions; support bundles report
  coverage, truncation and a 10 MiB ceiling without exposing subscriber or hardware identities.
- Fix [Issue #27](https://github.com/MddIdd/mdd-sim-gateway/issues/27): VLESS Encryption now
  reaches Xray instead of being replaced with `none`, which previously made every request time out.
  UDP exits are checked with interleaved STUN and DNS probes, an unavailable Xray affects only its
  own exits, and node tests show the actual Xray/sing-box failure output.
- Notification event switches now collapse like message templates, and channel test buttons show
  “Testing…” and reject duplicate clicks while a request is pending. Update-network and version-range
  guidance is displayed under the controls each description actually explains.

### 2. v1.7 feature overview

- Notifications now include Feishu/Lark with consistent event templates, test feedback, retry and
  delivery history.
- Configurable IKE-SA rekey and traceable automatic-recovery decisions improve long-running VoWiFi
  stability.
- Candidate management, explicit notification/update routes and fuller proxy diagnostics bring
  testing, rollback and troubleshooting into the WebUI.

Both Control and Engine are updated in this release.
